features: Two compact tools, a dark Desktop compose pane, and a 15 MB scannable catalog
v0.2.0 compose-v2: assetrizz_scene op=compose compiles a compact signed scene spec into a placed scene
Four gameplay templates: topdown_farming, topdown_shooter, dungeon_crawler, and side_platformer
Layer lint for collisions, HUD/playfield overlap, and off-canvas placement
On-demand fetches of single PNGs from the pinned library tag, SSRF-guarded and SHA-256 verified
Bulk library download is user-initiated only (pane button or CLI), not a model tool
use_cases: Ask the agent for a meadow, a ranger, or a roadside inn; it searches the catalog, places tiles and props, and renders a PNG
Live-preview the current scene in the dark Assetrizz Desktop pane on Hermes 0.23 or newer
Compose a top-down farming, top-down shooter, dungeon crawler, or side-platformer scene from a compact signed spec (compose-v2)
Lint a layout for collisions, HUD/playfield overlap, or off-canvas placement before you export
Keep the 1.65 GB art tree out of the plugins folder: install only the plugin repo (or, for the older layout, mojomast/assetrizz/plugin)
Download chosen style packs yourself when you want a local library; the agent cannot start a bulk download
install:
hermes plugins install mojomast/assetrizz-hermes --ref e710b89c276b210969bebd67db4f1c855541586a
hermes plugins enable assetrizz

--ref takes a 40-character commit SHA, not a tag name. Skill id: assetrizz:assetrizz-composer. The two tools still run when the Desktop pane is unavailable. Library PNGs are pinned to mojomast/assetrizz tag v0.1.0 (commit 05339c228f55ac95ad21b5c947db0c6e36207cd4).

video.note: Posted demo (180 seconds). Re-encoded to H.264 720p, faststart, under 14 MB. An 82-second shorter cut also existed locally; this pack uses the posted 180-second version.
